item.title: Author and environmental justice advocate set to speak at WCCS
item.description: Wallace Community College Selma (WCCS) is set to host An Evening of Scholarship, Story, and Legacy, a meet-the-author experience featuring Catherine Coleman Flowers on Monday, Feb. 2.

item.title: A new generation dreams with MLK
item.description: Selma students bring MLK’s “I Have a Dream” speech to life at historic Tabernacle Baptist Church during a wreath-laying service honoring Dr. King and Coretta Scott King.

item.title: Upcoming SRA luncheon to focus on tax credits
item.description: The Selma Redevelopment Authority is hosting Revitalizing Selma: A Tax Credits Luncheon on Tuesday, Feb. 3, at noon.

item.title: Panthers and Saints go head-to-head in crosstown clash at Southside
item.description: Southside High School played host to one of the most anticipated matchups of the season on Saturday, Jan. 24, as the Panthers faced off against crosstown rivals, the Selma High School Saints, on the Panthers’ home court.

item.title: Primary Eye Care offering free eye screenings Jan. 29
item.description: Visually Impaired People Organization, Inc. (V.I.P) has partnered with Selma’s Primary Eye Care to offer free glaucoma eye screenings in honor of January being Glaucoma Awareness Month.

item.title: National Championship Race: Evaluating the Leading Contenders
item.description: The national championship race has been framed as a stress test, where reputations have been reduced to what can be sustained over four quarters.

item.title: Southside Panthers take on the Thomasville Tigers
item.description: The Southside High School Panthers hosted another pivotal Class 3A area basketball matchup on Friday, Jan. 23, welcoming the Thomasville High School Tigers to their home court for an evening that featured contrasting outcomes in the girls' and boys' varsity contests.

item.title: Sen. Britt helps to secure over $11.5M in Congressional funding for Black Belt and River Region
item.description: U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Ala.), as a member of the Senate Committee on Appropriations, recently directly secured over $11.5 million for the River Region through the passage of three Fiscal Year (FY) 2026 appropriations bills.

item.title: IRS opens 2026 tax filing season
item.description: The Internal Revenue Service opened the 2026 tax filing season on Monday, Jan. 26, and began accepting and processing federal individual income tax returns for tax year 2025.

item.title: Missouri vs. Alabama NCAA Men’s Basketball Preview and Keys to the Game
item.description: The Missouri Tigers are headed to Tuscaloosa for a pivotal SEC showdown against the Alabama Crimson Tide.
